scope: Actual small comparison of whole-process extractors; no forecasting models, second-block effects or report work

shared_conditions.reference: explicit known simulation baseline, never the command or a fitted predictor

simulation.mechanism: Independent fine-grid first/second-order controlled dynamics, delayed changes, interruptions, rebound; native minute interval averaging. No inverse RIDE, TF, LABS or CPOP generation.
simulation.independence: New seeds and users; one event/user; no old test tuning. Test generated only after validation freeze. Within-block observations correlated; six seeds are descriptive limited evidence.

settings.ride_original: Unchanged existing production function and configured profile, n_starts minimum3; no oracle initialization
settings.ride_revised: Unchanged existing revised function, fixed starts and max_nfev250; same declared_headroom profile and physical data

tf_standard.covariance: mean uncentered squared residual of independent128 non-events; no predictor error exists

tf_gls.covariance: LedoitWolf centered residual covariance from same128 independent non-events; no new covariance tuning

settings.tf_interpretation: Existing estimator implementations, penalties fixed from prior pilot. Measurement-only noise recalibration for this new known-reference domain, not a replay of old unknown-reference freezes; std/GLS are bounded internal configurations.
settings.cpop: Unchanged native CRAN1.0.10, sd0.05, beta2log(n), minseglen0, exact prune, midpoint native grid

labs_2026.selection: Author sSIC solution path unchanged; internally estimates sigma, no task truth supplied

feature_definition: Shared production _features/_frozen_f0 for fitted and evaluator clean minute curves. Cumulative/longest threshold duration, onset interval, target interval and missing category, first postwindow recovery-band entrance, curve, task/post energy. Recovery is first dwell entrance, not permanent physical completion.
primary_selection_metric: Mean over all validation tasks of 0.5*(absolute cumulative-duration error+absolute longest-duration error), seconds. Incomplete methods cannot be selected by deleting failed rows.
selection_rule: Among non-control candidate ride_original/ride_revised/tf_standard/tf_gls/labs_2026 with 100% available validation, select smallest primary error, tie within1e-9 then smaller mean solver time. Raw and CPOP are formal feature-block controls; both always reported. Freeze this choice before test; no test-based switching.
recommendation_gate: For a positive improvement recommendation selected candidate must reduce primary test error at least10% versus existing ride_revised; pooled curve RMSE must not increase; null raw-duration false tasks cannot exceed ride_revised by more than1 of24; all outputs retained. CPOP superiority remains visible. No automatic global-default replacement even if gate passes.
secondary_metrics: onset/target finite timing error and absent-status disagreement across all tasks
raw accounting eta identical across methods
real_data: Separate fixed KIT command/current sample prepared by real_preparation_protocol; seconds/A dimensionless tracking, not production minute/kW RIDE. Raw/TFstd/CP/LABS share same aggregation. Original-record agreement and injected-corruption preservation are robustness diagnostics, not latent-clean or causal truth; no new predictor.
limits: Known simulation baseline cannot validate unknown-baseline field performance
KIT current command is not untreated power
No calibrated5% detection claim from this study
No claim one continuous-piecewise-linear model handles all discontinuities
No existing mature method renamed as innovation
stop: One fixed comparison; preserve all negative results; no parameter enlargement, new dependencies, GPU, report, other resources, second-block algorithms, deletion, upload or commit.
